messages:
karen_cust: Hey team — customer reported embeddings requests from our EU tenant returning wrong dims and huge latency this morning. They saw `InvalidEmbeddingDimension: expected 1536 got 384` and several 5xx spikes. Billing also spiked because their client retried. Any known routing/capacity issues?
jordan_support: Sorry about that — do you have a request id or example payload?
karen_cust: request id: r-0a7f3e, sample curl attached:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \u002dH 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \u002dH 'Region: eu-central-1' \u002dH 'Content-Type: application/json' \u002d-d '{"model":"embed-large-v1","input":"test"}'
```
Response snippet:
```json
{ "error": "InvalidEmbeddingDimension", "expected": 1536, "got": 384, "model_served": "embed-small-quant" }
```
This started ~08:05 CET and lasted ~20m.
sana_ml: that "model_served" field stands out — looks like a smaller quantized variant got routed. Could be fallback to lower-tier pool during a capacity pressure event. Did the tenant have any region pinning?
karen_cust: they set Region header to eu-central-1 explicitly. I confirmed via logs from their side.
liam_infra: looking at infra metrics — we had a sudden coldstart storm in eu-central-1 at 08:04 CET, instance churn + a queued backlog. Smart routing policy allowed cross-region spillover to us-west-2 to maintain throughput. That would explain smaller model variant if us-west pool had different default model family.
jordan_support: can you paste the routing log for r-0a7f3e?
liam_infra: log:
```
[08:04:22 CET] request r-0a7f3e tenant=acct-42 prefer_region=eu-central-1 routed_to=us-west-2 pool=fill-small-quant reason=fallback_capacity
[08:04:22 CET] started_instance coldstart id=i-0f3 restart_latency=4.2s
```
maria_oncall: ops_bot alerted us at 08:05 for queue depth > 250 and auto-fallback kicked in. I've got the incident page up: https://internal/ops/incidents/INC-2026-042
ops_bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created: EU capacity pressure, fallback routing enabled, 08:05 CET.
sana_ml: technical root cause: when fallback routing picks a pool that hosts a different model family/quantization, the signature (embedding dim) can differ. We should never route to a pool with incompatible model dims. That's a config bug in smart routing.
karen_cust: customer is asking for repro steps and mitigation. They want to avoid billing from retries.
jordan_support: immediate mitigation — ask them to set explicit model variant in payload: \"model\":\"embed-large-v1:strict-variant\" which will cause our API to fail fast instead of routing to incompatible variant. Also throttle client retries and set exponential backoff.
liam_infra: medium-term fix: add a routing compatibility check to ensure model_dim matches across fallback candidates. I'm opening ENGINFRA-3421 to track. Also provisioning a small standby warm pool in eu-central-1 to reduce coldstart churn.
maria_oncall: deployment note: rolling patch to routing layer to prevent cross-pool incompatible fallback will be pushed at 10:30 CET, low-risk toggle. Will post rollout and rollback steps.
jordan_support: asking customer for logs + billing statements so we can credit excess charges while we fix. Karen, can you request that and offer a temporary promo credit?
karen_cust: sent message to customer with repro & suggested temp fix + request for logs. Also offered to pause billing on the impacted endpoint while we investigate. They replied they can provide logs and want ETA.
sana_ml: for logs please include the `model_served` and `model_version` fields if present, and the full `X-Request-Routing` header. That will let us map to pool.
liam_infra: for the record, quick fix that reduces blast radius: set fallback_policy=region_only for tenants with strict model contracts. We'll add a tenant setting flag.
maria_oncall: update: roll out scheduled and ENGINFRA-3421 created. I'll stay on call for the next 90m.
jordan_support: thanks team. I'll keep customer updated and loop in billing.
karen_cust: customer acknowledged the workaround and will apply strict variant. They asked for a postmortem once routing fix is live.
sana_ml: note for postmortem — include timeline, number of tenants impacted, avg extra tokens billed, and a test to catch mismatched dims in canary.
maria_oncall: noted. Thanks all :thumbsup:
